q1.question: What is your typical project timeline?
q1.answer: Our timelines vary depending on the scope and complexity of the project. A standard web application MVP might take 6 to 10 weeks, while large-scale enterprise solutions and ERP systems can take 3 to 6 months. We break development into agile sprints to ensure continuous delivery and feedback.

q2.question: Do you offer post-launch support and maintenance?
q2.answer: Yes, we provide ongoing support, maintenance, and optimization services. We monitor system performance, perform security patches, and can continuously iterate on features based on user feedback and business growth.

q3.question: What technologies do you specialize in?
q3.answer: We focus on modern, scalable technology stacks including React, TypeScript, Node.js, Next.js, and Firebase or Cloud SQL for databases. For mobile, we leverage cross-platform frameworks to ensure high performance on both iOS and Android.

q4.question: How do you handle project communication?
q4.answer: We believe in total transparency. Our clients have access to a dedicated Client Portal where they can track project milestones, view staging links, and directly chat with the Development Team in real-time.

q5.question: Can you integrate with our existing backend or third-party APIs?
q5.answer: Absolutely. We have extensive experience in seamless API integrations, migrating legacy databases, and connecting modern applications with established enterprise software (CRMs, payment gateways, etc.).
